description: A vintage wooden desk set up as a workstation, featuring a reel-to-reel tape recorder, a vintage computer monitor and keyboard, a desk lamp, file holders, a potted cactus, and various papers and office supplies. A black office chair with a document on its seat is positioned in front of the desk. The overall impression is one of a retro, perhaps clandestine or research-oriented workspace, with a sense of focused activity.
